title: Excalibur
blurb: A fast-playing Arthurian adventure for anywhere from two players to a full round table of knights. Short rounds keep the focus on quick decisions rather than long-term planning.

caption: A fast-playing Arthurian adventure for anywhere from two players to a full round table of knights.

caption: A quick, elimination-driven hidden-role game of duels and betrayal dressed up in swashbuckling finery.
